messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick heads-up  AcmePay token activity down ~55% over last 14 days. New procurement lead joined and is running a CloudX pilot. Need fast triage.
Alex (CS): Seen the alert. When did the new lead come in and was there any note about performance concerns?
Priya (CSM): Mark P. started last Friday. Their onboarding notes: 'evaluating latency and TCO vs alternatives'. No billing disputes on file.
Jordan (AE): Mark specifically asked about latency numbers and cost per 1k tokens vs CloudX. We have Dedicated benchmarks for comparable loads.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll pull the model routing and token distribution. Planned SQL: `SELECT date, tokens, model, route FROM usage WHERE account='acmepay' AND date >= now() - interval '14 days' ORDER BY date DESC;`
DevBot: Alert: account=acmepay volume -55% vs 14d avg. https://redwood.alerts/ACME-123 :rotating_light:
Alex (CS): Priya  can you confirm last success call date and whether engineering flagged any perf regressions? Also ask customer for 3 representative prompts (small/medium/large).
Priya (CSM): Last success call 2026-03-02. No regressions noted. I'll request sample prompts and avg token lengths from Mark. Scheduling: trying to get Mark + engineering on Tue.
Jordan (AE): Proposal: short proof-of-performance  a 2-week Dedicated canary with our latency SLO + a brief cost comparison that includes batching/quantization assumptions.
Ravi (Solutions): I can prepare the perf config. Need sample payloads and typical sequence length. Priya, can you collect the three prompt examples?
Priya (CSM): Will request them now and push into a shared doc.
Alex (CS): Action owners: I'll draft the 1-pager (TCO + perf summary). Jordan will handle commercial terms and trial credit. Ravi add before/after perf + cost calc. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Solutions): Perf command I'll run locally: `./perf/run.sh --acct acmepay --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --duration 600 --batch 8`  will attach results.
Jordan (AE): Suggest offering a 30-day Dedicated trial credit + provisional SLA for the pilot window to reduce friction around renewal.
Priya (CSM): Tentative meeting Tue 11:00. If we can show parity on p50/p95 latency and ~20% cost savings with batching, we may de-escalate churn risk. I'll capture competitive questions in the brief.
Alex (CS): Added to renewal-risk tracker, tags: `competitive-pilot`, `usage-drop`. Keep updates here.
DevBot: Reminder: follow-up on 1-pager Monday 16:00 UTC.
